rows.grounds: past passive participle agreeing with subject

items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings fall within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
Those womb-diagrams serve as sites of confinement.
Confinement within them results in torment for those present.
items.inference: Beings are tormented by virtue of their placement in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent of torment is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
